༄༅/ /sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i khrid yig bde chen myur gter bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i khrid yig bde chen myur gter bzhugs/

na mo gu ra we/ mchog 'dod rnams la bdud rtsi lta bu'i gtam/ / dpag yas mkha' 'gro'i dbang po'i nyer brtan pa/ /'phags yul grub pa'i thugs bcud 'dir babs kyi/ /blo ldan skal bzang tshogs rnams yi rang byos/ /dri med nam mkha'i lus can 'od 'bar ma/ /gnyen lcug 'khril ldem rdo rje gar gyi ros/ /'pho ba'i gdung sel bde ba rab byin ma/ /sgyu 'phrul bdag mo 'phags ma sgrol mar 'dud/ /ma bcos rig pa gtsor gyur gang*/ / lhag bsam shing rtas nyer drangs te/ /bla med ye shes 'od stong can/ /sngon med gang de 'di na shar/ /'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhi ba sbas pa'i zhal snga nas kyi man ngag gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po bla ma'i zhal snga nas 'byung ba mdo tsam rjod par bya ste/ thog mar sdig sgrib sbyang ba ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba las/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /ye shes me dpung dkar po bsam/ /sems can khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /gnas las me ni 'bar bar sgrub/ /mtshams med lnga dag byed pa yang*/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa rdo rje'i ye shes 'dis/ /skad cig gis ni dpal ldan 'gyur/ /ces gsungs te/ rang dam tshig sems dpar gsal ba'am/ tha mal par gnas kyang rung ste/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su lha mo sgrol ma phyag bzhi ma 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba de'i thugs kar zla ba la taṃ gy-i tha mar sngags kyi bskor ba/ yig 'bru thams cad las me dkar po 'bar ba bsam ste/ sngags bzlas pas/ me lce de nyid cher 'bar te ye shes sems dpa'i sku gang*/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi po rnams nas rim gyis 'bar bas/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad me ri dkar po rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par bsam/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi sgo dgu nas me lce yongs su 'jug cing*/

de'i rkyen gyis kyang snying ga'i thig le me dpung dkar po'i ngo bor gyur/ lus thams cad mes gang ste/ de'i 'od kyi sems can de rnams kyis sdig sgrib bsregs par bsam/ mthar me rnams rang gi snying ga'i me la bsdu'o/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba pā paṃ k+ṣa yaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas bar chad bzlog par byed pa ni/ rgyud las/ spu las nad rnams spre'u'am/ khyi dang 'dra bar rab tu dbyung*/ /nad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig 'dis/ /rdo rje mtshon chas bsnun par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ snying gar ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' taṃ yig ljang khur rab tu 'bar ba/ de'i 'od zer rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi nas brgyud de rtsa thams cad rab tu khyab pas/ nad rnams dang*/ nad du 'gyur ba'i rgyu dang*/ gdon dang bar chad thams cad me lce'i gdung bas phyir ded de/ nad rnams spre'u'i rnam pas dang*/ gdon rnams khyi'i rnam pas ba spu'i bu ga nas phyi rol du phyung ste/ yang sa bon gyi 'od zer me lce lta bu dang*/ rab tu rno ba'i mtshon cha'i tshogs spros te/ nad gdon de rnams phye mar gtubs shing me lcais bsregs pas/ thal bar gyur la/ thal ba'ang rlung gi gtor bar bsam/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba ro ga nā sha ya nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o/ /byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rgyud las/ zla ba nyi ma'i rlung gi dbus/ /rang sngags sa bon sgom par bya/ /lha yi de nyid dmigs gyur na/ /bcu drug pa la de 'grub 'gyur/ /ces gsungs te/ rang gtso mor bsam pa'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yang gsal btab nas ro ma'i dwangs ma lte ba'i gtum mo dang bcas pa/ chos 'khor gyi lte bar nyi ma dang*/ rkyang ma'i dwangs ma spyi bo'i haṃ dang bcas pa snying ga'i dbus su son pa/ zla bar gyur/ de gnyis kyi dbus su mi shigs pa'i rlung taṃ yig ljang khu/

de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa la sgrol ma phyag bzhi ma/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la taṃ ljang khu 'od zer 'phro ba/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying ga chos 'khor gyi 'og tu hūṃ rnams bsam la/ oṃ āḥtaṃ hūṃ ces ma yengs pa'i yid kyi rtag tu bzlas pa bya'o/ /phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa bzlog par 'dod na/ rgyud las/ rang sngags sa bon 'od zer gyi/ /rdo rje gur sogs rtag par bya/ / 'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung ba dang*/ /lus med rnams kyis kyang mi mthong*/ / zhes te/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs snga ma bzhin du sgoms la/ sa bon sngags bcas las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir song*/ ji tsam bsrung ba'i sa phyogs de tsam du ut+pal dmar po'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur de'i phyi rol phyogs kun tu/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ me'i gseb thams cad khro mo drag gtum 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra sgrog pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams kyis khengs shing*/ de rnams kyi phyi rol steng gi nam mkha' char sprin glog 'gyu bas khyab pa/ khor yug thams cad de las byung ba'i rdo rje me lce'i ser ba 'bab cing*/ 'og gi gzhi thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi me lce rab tu 'bar ba can du bsam la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+taṃ pra duṣ+taṃ ma ma kri te dzam bha ya a s+t+wam bha ya mo ha ya ban+dha ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra rak+ṣa tsakra sā dha ya sā dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa bya'o/ /de dag ni bskyed rim rnal 'byor chen po ste sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ spyir rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi rnal 'byor bzhi las/ rnal 'byor dang po ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa 'khor bcas yin la/ rnal 'byor phyi ma gsum ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin pas 'dir de rnams bshad na/ rjes su rnal 'byor la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi bogs 'don gsum las/

dang po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun gnad du phab nas/ mig sna rtser blta zhing*/ sems yang der gtad la/ sna nang du 'od dmar ser du ba lta bu yal la la 'dug pa la dmigs/ yang na mig gnyis sna'i rtsa ba la blta zhing*/ smin mtshams kyi gnas der thig le dkar po 'od 'tsher ba zhig la sems gtad/ de rnams mi bde na lag len bzhin smin mtshams nas mtho gang ngam/ khru gang tsam bcal ba'i nam mkha' la che re mig gis blta zhing*/ rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa cung zad kyang mi byed par rang lugs su bzhag /de gsum la brten nas rtags snang du ma mthong ba dang*/ nang byang ba dang*/ thig le brtan pa dang*/ zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin mtha' dbus med pa skye'o/ /gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor gyi gzhi zhi gnas de nyid cung zad brtan nas/ kha nang log gi shes pas rang rig de nyid ngo shes kyi tshul du che re bltas pas/ brjod bral gyi ngang nas rig stong ma 'gags pa la mnyam par bzhag ste/ sems rang byung du shes par bya'o/ /rnam par rtog pa dang yul gyi snang ba ci byung yang*/ skyes tsam nyid nas de nyid kyi ngo bo ngo shes bsten par bya ste/ rnam rtog rang byung du shes par byed pa'o/ /de ltar yang rgyud las/ dngos po bde rdzun rnams dpyad na/ /brdzun pa'i rdo rje yang dag mthong*/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho na/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa la/ gzungs kyi sgos bogs 'don pa dang*/ bdud gzhom pas bogs 'don pa'o/ /dang po ni rgyud las rnam grangs mang bar gsungs kyang*/ man ngag tu rnam pa dgu po 'di dag mdzad de/ dang po ni/ a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i ngang nas lus kyi snying ga'i gnas su sems gtad la/ a zhes bya ba'i gdangs shig bsam ste/ de'i ngo bo la rnam par dpyad na/ de lta bu'i gdangs de/ dbang po lnga'i yul du mi snang zhing*/

lus kyi phyi nang gang du yang med pas ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba rnam par yid ngor lam me snang ba ma 'gags pa de nyid la che re bltas shing legs par brtags na/ rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings la mnyam par 'jog /ngag tu a zhes brjod cing*/ sgra de dang sngar yid yul du bsam pa'i a zhes bya ba'i sgra spyi de la 'brel ba 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ de yang yid la dngos po gzhan zhig bsam kyang a zhes ngag tu brjod du rung la/ a yig gi sgra spyi bsam bzhin du tshig gi brjod pa gzhan yang 'byung bar mthong bas de gnyis 'brel ba med par thag bcad la/ yang yang mnyam par bzhag /de la a ni yi ge thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin cing*/ de'i sgra don rang bzhin med par shes pas ngag thams cad grag stong du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ / de tsam gyis kyang thag ma chod na/ ming don gzhan gyi steng du gtan la 'bebs te/ lhas byin zhes pa lta bu/ rang bzhin gyi ming gang yang rung ba zhig yid la bsam ste/ tshig spyir snang ba'i rnam rtog de la snang ba ltar don la med pa gong bzhin thag bcad/ de dang ngag tu brjod pa la'ang 'brel ba med par gong bzhin thag bcad/ sgra rtog de gnyis dang rang gi lus sems la 'brel ba ci yang mi snang ste/ gal te de la 'brel ba yod na ming de kho na las don de'i rnam pa 'char dgos pa las/ don de la gzhan mang por ming btags kyang*/ rnam rtog gis bzhag pa'i tshe de dang de'i rnam pa 'char zhing*/ rnam rtog gi ma bzhag pa'i tshe/ lhas byin zhes brjod kyang skyes bu lhas byin gyi rnam pa mi 'char ba bzhin/ ming thams cad de dang 'dra bar shes par byas la yang yang mnyam par bzhag pas/ sgra thams cad brag cha dang 'dra bar nges par rtog par 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa ni hūṃ gi gzungs te/ sngar gyi zhi lhag de dang 'brel ba'i ngang nas/ rang gi lus kyi khong la sems gtad de/ hūṃ ring po yang yang brjod pa la dmigs skor gcig go

/de nas ye shes lnga ldan du sgom ste/ ci yang mi bsam zhing bzo bcos med par 'jog pa ni chos dbyings ye shes so/ /de'i ngang nas sems kyi ngo bo la cher gyis bsgrims nas blta ba ni me long ye shes so/ /lus sems nang dang snang ba gzhan rnams phyi ste/ phyi nang thams cad la dmigs nas che re blta zhing lhod kyi glod pa ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /de kha'i ngang nas lha sku gsal stong du lam gyi 'char bar byas nas de la ma bcos par 'jog pa ni/ sor rtog ye shes so/ /sems can thams cad la snying rje dung tsam sgom zhing snga ma'i ngang bskyang ba ni bya sgrub ye shes so/ /de ltar lnga po re re la zan khams gcig za ba'i yun tsam re 'jog cing*/ dmigs pa re re 'pho mtshams su hūṃ ring po re brjod do/ /bar skabs su snga ma ltar lta ba yun ring du bskyang ste/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /'dis ni skad cig re rer dmigs pa sna tshogs la dbang thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni phaṭa kyi gzungs kyi sgo ste/ de yang sngar gyi zhi lhag gi ngang nas/ sems gnas pa las rnam rtog gi 'char sgo nam byung ba'i tshe/ phaṭa yig brjod par bya'o snyam nas dran pa yang yang bzhag /rnam rtog nam skyes pa'i tshe phaṭa brjod/ ched kyi 'phro ni mi gcod/ rnam rtog de yal ba'i tshe yang phaṭa yig brjod/ de 'gags nas gzhan zhig shar na phaṭa yig brjod/ gang ltar na'ang sems kyi 'char sgo/ skye 'gag ci byed kyang*/ spang blang dgag sgrub gzhan ni mi byed la phaṭa yig rtag tu dran cing brjod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni khaṃ gi gzungs kyi sgo ste/ de yang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa shugs drag po ci shar yang*/ dngos po thams cad nam mkhar sgom pa ste/ dper na 'di ni mi yin no snyam pa'i tshe khaṃ zhes brjod cing mi de nyid nam mkha' dang dbyer med du yal bar bsam la cung zad bzhag /des mtshon pa'i 'di ni 'di'o zhes 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi yul thams cad dang*/

khyad par bde sdug dga' skyo 'jigs skrag zhum pa yang ngo tsha nga rgyal skye ba sogs mtho dman gyi yul thams cad la mnyam par bsre/ lnga pa ni/ aḥ'i gzungs te/ gnyis su snang ba thams cad la/ de gnyis ka'i ngo bo la cher gyi bltas pas/ snang ba'i dmigs gtad mnyam du zhig pa la cham me 'jog pa ste/ dper na rang dang dgra gnyis kyi snang ba lam gyi shar ba na/ snang ba gnyis po de'i steng du cher gyis bltas pas/ ngos bzung gi mtshan ma zhig pa'i ngang der cham gyis mnyam par 'jog /rim pa de kho nas/ bzang ngan mtho dman/ che chung legs nyes/ g.yas g.yon/ mtha' dbus/ snyan mi snyan/ bde sdug sogs thams cad la sbyar bas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /drug pa ni/ ya yig ste/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gcig bsam la/ ngag tu yaṃ zhes brjod cing*/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor de/ gnas gang na gnas/ tshad ji tsam/ kha dog dang dbyibs su ji ltar grub/ sems su grub bam phyi rol du grub ces dpyad na/ der snang tsam zhig ma gtogs/ bden dngos su grub rgyu cung zad kyang med pa'i gsal stong la mnyam par bzhag ste/ yig ngor sgom pa ste dmigs pa dang po'o/ /yang rlung gi reg bya la bslab pa ste/ dkar khung la sogs pa nas/ rlung 'jam po dag ldang pa rang gi lus la phog par byas te/ de'i reg bya yang zhing 'jam pa yul yul po de la sems rtse gcig tu bsres te reg bya de 'dra pa la mnyam par bzhag / skabs 'gar rang lus snang ba dang bcas pa/ rlung gi reg bya tsam de la thim par bsam/ de gcig pu ma gtogs gzhan gang yang mi bsam par ci nus mnyam par bzhag /ngag tu yaṃ zhes rtag tu bzla bar bya'o/ /dmigs pa gnyis pa'o/ /bdun pa ni raṃ yig gi gzungs kyi sgo ste/ de yang dmigs pa dang po'o/ / raṃ bzla zhing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni khyad par te/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ me nyid kyi rnam pa la bslab pa ni/ 'grub na 'og tu bud shing*/

bar du me 'bar ba/ steng nas du ba mthul ba'i thab zhig byas la/ de la lta zhing*/ gzhan yid la mi byed par/ de gcig pu la blta zhing*/ de'i thad du de dang 'dra ba'i me zhig yid la 'char bar byas te/ slar de nyid kyi steng du sngar bzhin cham me mnyam par bzhag /de nas snang ba gzhan shar ba kun kyang me de la bsres pas/ thams cad me'i rnam pa 'ba' zhig tu lam lam 'gyur ba la sems gtad do/ / brgyad pa ni/ wa yig gi gzungs kyi sgo la dmigs pa dang pau/ /waṃ bzla zhing chu'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni gong ma gnyis dang 'dra/ mdun du chu snod dwangs pa zhig tu chu gtsang 'jug /de la blta zhing*/ chu de nyid kyi thad du de kho na dang 'dra ba'i chu zhig yid kyis bsam ste/ yang de kha'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /rnam rtog gang shar ba'i yul de mdun gyi chu dang bsres te/ gzhan mi bsam par chu 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i tshul gyis sgoms/ dgu pa ni/ la yig gi gzungs ni/ dmigs pa dang po/ laṃ bzla zhing sa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa sogs 'dra/ mdun du sa'i rnam pa zlum po'am gru bzhi mtshon sna lnga po gang yang rung ba legs po zhig gis kha bsgyur ba zhig byas la/ de la blta zhing*/ de'i thad du de dang 'dra ba'i kha dog can sra ba zhig sgom/ gzhan gang yang mi bsam/ de nas gang snang thams cad kha dog can gyi sa'i gzugs brnyan de la thim par sgom/ lhag ma bzhi po de ni/ gzungs kyi sgo bla ma rnams kyi yan lag yin no/ /gnyis pa mi mthun phyogs gsal ba bdud gzhom pa ni/ dang por bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ sngar bzhin zhi lhag gnyis sgoms la/ rnam rtog gi 'char sgo ci byung yang*/ hūṃ zhes brjod cing 'phro bcad/ thun mtshams rnams su/ spyod lam sna tshogs pa dang bsres te/ dper na rjes su rnal 'byor gyi gzhi la gnas bzhin pas/ 'og khang nas khang steng lta bur 'gro ba'am/ snang ba'i sa nas mun par 'jug pa'am/ mun pa'i sa nas snang ba dang bcas pa'i sar 'gro ba dang*/

nang nas phyi rol du spyod pa la sogs pa yul dus bya ba mi 'dra ba re la/ sems kyi 'gyur ba'i khyad par re yong bas de kun la hūṃ zhes bya bas 'phro bcad cing stong pa nyid dang bsres te/ dmigs skor gcig

/yang dga' sdug chags sdang 'jigs pa la sogs par snang ba thams cad la/ de bzhin bsre ste dmigs skor gcig /gnod byed dgra dang gdon yid yul du bsam ste snying rje drag tu bsgoms pas/ hūṃ zhes brjod cing de dang rang sems dbyer med du bsre ste dmigs skor gcig /yang nye du la sogs pa chags yul yid la bsam ste/ hūṃ zhes zhen pa bcad la/ de dang rang sems bsres te bzhag pa dmigs skor gcig /'byung ba dang sems can la brten pa'i yang 'jigs pa thams cad la yang de bzhin du sbyang ba dmigs skor gcig ste lnga'o/ /de ltar rang gi khyim du legs par 'byongs pa na/ mtshan mo dur khrod la sogs par yud re song la sems brtan mi brtan brtag /mi brtan na re zhig rang gi khyim du sgom/ gang gi tshe brtan pa na dur khrod dang*/ bas mtha' la sogs par/ gnod sbyin dang srin po 'byung po gnas pa'i sar chos brgyad dang mthun pa'i rnam par rtog pa hrul gyis bshig nas/ yul dus spyod lam ma nges par rgyus pas/ sems kyi 'gyur ba ci byung ba thams cad hūṃ gis sgras sngar bzhin bsre bar bya'o/ /cho 'phrul lhar snang ba thams cad rang gi sems su shes par bya zhing*/ gnod byed rnams la snying rje drag tu sgom zhing smon lam btab/ lus dang longs spyod rang phyogs kyi sde dang bcas pa gang la yang zhen pa rdul tsam med par bya zhing*/ bde sdug bzang ngan gtam snyan mi snyan sogs/ chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa phra mo ci byung ba kun yang dbyings su thim par bya'o/ /mi mthun phyogs bsal ba 'di ni rjes su rnal 'byor bogs 'don dang bcas pa la cung zad myong ba thon nas sgom par bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la dngos dang yan lag go /dang po la/ pu ra ka ste dgang pa dang*/ re tsa ka ste dbyung ba'am/ rdul mtha' can dang*/ bhu myang ga ste/

sa'i yan lag dang*/ kum+pa ka ste bum pa can dang*/ trā ṭa ka ste gzhil ba'am rengs pa/ dang po pu ra ka la gnyis kyi sgra bcas ni/ lus gnad bcas la/ rlung phyir gsang ba lan 'ga' re bya/ sems sna rtser gtad la/ rlung phyir sangs te bus la/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe dal bus shugs 'phri zhing*/ sna'i rtsa ba'i bar ka la rlung bdar bas a yig gi sgra dang bcas pa yun ring du drangs shing*/ de'i tshe shes pa lte bar gtad/ drangs pa rdzogs pa na/ cung zad cig rlung lte bar mnan/ yang btang ste sngar bzhin drangs/ de nyid rtag tu goms par bya'o/ /sgra med la slob pa ni/ gzhan de dang 'dra ba la/ rlung dal bus sna'i bu ga'i dbus nas drangs pas/ sgra med du 'gyur ro/ /re tsa ka la'ang gnyis kyi sgra bcas ni/ rlung ro lan 'ga' bsal la/ nang du myur bar rngubs/ sna rtse nas sor bzhi tsam gzhal ba'i nam mkha' la sems gtad de/ dal bus rlung phyir btang ste/ sna'i sbubs kyi bar ka la gdar bas/ sgra dang bcas par 'gyur te/ rlung phyir 'gro ba rdzogs pa na/ cung zad cig phyir drag tu mnan/ lus dang snang ba thams cad stong sangs kyis song bar bsam/ de nyid yang nas yang du sgom par bya'o/ /sgra med ni/ dal bus rang babs su gtong ba ste/ gzhan ni 'dra'o/ / gsum pa bhu myang ga ni/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma yas sna spyi bo dang*/ mas sna lte bar phyin pa/ spyi bo la zla ba dang*/ lte bar nyi ma/ khams dkar dmar gyi rang bzhin rtsa mdud bral ma kha mthur bstan sbrul nag po lta bu lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar dbu ma la dkris shing*/ mgrin pa nas mjug ma mdun du 'khyogs te lce rtser slem pa zhig sgom/ rlung ro bsal te/ rlung dal bus rngubs pas/ zla ba las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun byung*/ dbu ma gang ste/ lte ba na skya chil li li 'dug par bsam/ rngub pa rdzogs pa na/ dal bus phyir btang bas/ lte ba'i nyi ma las rak+ta'i rgyun byung ba dkar po dang 'dres pas/

bdud bral ma mas yar rim gyi khengs/ lce rtse'i bar du thig le dkar dmar gyi khyab par bsam/ 'di rgyud nas gsal kha mi 'byung bas/ rdzogs rim 'di'i skabs su ma bstan kyang rung bar mngon/ bzhi pa bum pa can la/ dang por rlung ro bsal zhing*/ rlung dal bus rngubs nas lte bar drag tu mnan/ thur sel rang dgar bzhag /kha nang nas rlung yang nas yang du mid pas/ rang lus lha sku khang stong du gnas pa de rgya je che je che la 'gro bar bsam ste/ 'di la dmigs skor gcig tu mdzad/ yang gzhan 'dra ba la/ rang lus rtsa gsum dang bcas pa gsal 'debs shing*/ thur sel drag tu 'then nas kha sbyor sgom pa ste/ 'di bum pa can dngos yin no/ /lnga pa trā ṭa ka ni/ rlung ro bsal la mig gnyis dpral ba'i dbyings su drag tu gtad/ rlung nang du rngubs te/ lte bar steng 'og kha sbyor byas pa/ de nyid g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dbus rnams su gnon 'then drag tu byed cing*/ sems kyi ci yang mi bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan lus la nye bar mkho ba rnams te/ rgyud las/ haḥzhes bya bas mchog tu dga' ba'i tshe bcing bar bya'o/ / yang na hūṃ zhes bya ba snying ga la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /yang na hrīṃ ha zhes bya ba mgrin pa la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi bya ba dang*/ mda' bo che'i sbyor ba byas la khu ba bcing bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang cha bzhi pa'i phyed kyi mtshams su/ lhan cig skyes pa sgom par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po ha yig gi las ni/ gsang bar ha ser po zhig sgom la/ ngag tu haḥzhes dal la ring ba khong shugs che ba brjod pas/ haḥyig de nyid gyen du byung*/ kha nas phyi rol du rgyang gyis thon par bsam/ mthar haḥyig drag tu brjod pas/ rlung phyir drag tu bus/ yang dal bus rngub pa sngar bzhin bya/ gnyis pa hūṃ 'dren ni/ lte bar hūṃ gcig sgom/ kha btsum zhing sre ba'i sbubs nas hūṃ dal la ring ba sna sgo nas brjod/

hūṃ de lte ba nas dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ spyi gtsug tshang bug tu sleb par bsam zhing*/ mthar hūṃ thung drag po zhig brjod/ gsum pa hrīṃ 'dren ni lkog mas ol mdud mnan nas hrīṃ ring po lan mang du ma chad par brjod cing*/ rlung phyir drag tu btang*/ mthar rdzogs mtshams su ha zhes shugs phyung la drag tu brjod pas/ snying ga nas/ rlung drod kyi rang bzhin kha dog dmar po zhig phyur gyis song la spyi bo nas thon par bsam/ bzhi pa ni rdo rje nor bur hūṃ yig sngon po 'od 'bar ba mgo bo gyen du bstan pa zhig bsam/ snga ma dang 'dra bar hūṃ ring gis rlung phyir ston pas/ hūṃ yig de nyid dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas/ spyi bo'i steng du thon par bsam/ hūṃ thung gis rngubs te phaṭa ces dran pas/ 'og rlung 'then/ kha sbyor stod du drag tu bsgril bas/ dbu ma mas sna nas yar thung ril li li 'gril te/ spyi bor gong bu gcig tu gyur pa la sems gtad/ lnga pa ni/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba'i ngang nas/glo bur du bshang sgor drag tu sdigs la/ cung zad cig mnan/ yang kha sbyor byed pa sogs/ de nyid skyar gyin sgom pa yin no/ /rlung sbyor de rnams kyi phan yon ni/ dgang ba'i sbyor bas grang ba dang*/ /gzhan yang sked pa'i nad sel zhing*/ /rmu chu la sogs pa sel/ drod skye ba dang*/ stong nyams shas che bar 'gyur/ dbyung bas ni/ mgo bo'i nad dang*/ mig nad dang*/ ro stod 'tshang ba dang*/ shes pa 'phyo ba la sogs pa sel lo/ /gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye zhing*/ /lus ldang ba yang bar 'gyur ro/ /bhu myāng ga ni/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bzlog cing tshe ring bar byed pa'o/ /bum pa can ni/ yon tan de thams cad byed cing*/ gzhan yang*/ chur mi bying ba sogs/ 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa rnams rnam par gnon/ trā ṭa kas ni/ srog thur gong bu gcig tu byed cing*/ ma zhu ba la sogs khong pa'i nad thams cad 'joms/

hāḥ'adren gyi dga' ba'i ye shes brtan/ snying rlung dang stod 'tshang la sogs pa sel bar byed/ hūṃ 'dren gyi bgegs kyi bar chad mi 'jug cing*/ mchog dga'i ye shes brtan par byed/ hrīṃ 'dren gyi gre ba'i nad sel zhing*/ khyad dga'i ye shes brtan par byed/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi mda' gzhus lhan skyes spyi bor brtan cing*/ snga ma thams cad kyi bya ba byed/ cha bzhi pa'i mtshams kyi sbyor bas/ kun+da brtan pa dang*/ srog thur bsre ba yin no/ /de thams cad kyang rlung sems dbu mar 'ching bar byed cing*/ rtsa mdud 'joms pa dang*/ snyigs ma'i lus dag pa'i skur yongs su bsgyur ba ste/ dang po lnga ni 'khor lo bzhi la sogs par kun+da brtan par byed pa dang*/ de nas bzhis kun+da 'dren pa dang*/ phyi ma ni 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang seng ge rnam rol la sogs pa ni thun mong du snang bas ma bkod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rnal 'byor dang po bskyed rim cung zad brtan cing*/ rjes su rnal 'byor gyis lta ba la nyams myong cung zad thon nas/ rlung gis rnal 'byor gyis rtsa lam byang ba zhig gis/ dngos gzhi pho nya'i lam la 'jug pa yin te/ rgyud las/ 'di la dgang ba dang*/ gzhil ba dang*/ rengs pa dang bum pa can gyi sbyor bas dag par byas nas/ mi mo rnams kyi sbyor ba la 'jug ste/ lus 'di nyid kyis dngos grub thob pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ bskul byed byed pa drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam bzhag dang*/ sngon goms pa'i rlung gi rnal 'byor rnams la brten nas/ dbab pa dang*/ bzung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ khyab pa dang ye shes su bskyal pa rnams rim can du bsgoms pas/ gtso bor las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ yan lag tu ye shes kyi phyag rgyas kyang rung ste/ gzhan lus la brten nas bde stong gi ye shes sgom pa yin no/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po ni/ rnam pa gsum ste/ lus mi bshig pa'i rnal 'byor/

ngag mi bshig pa'i rnal 'byor/ sems mi bshig pa'i rnal 'byor te gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud las/ lte ba'i dbus su re ga bsam/ /a ni mchog tu phra ba ste/ /mi 'gyur nyams dga' bde ba'i gnas/ /mi bshig tshangs pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang nyid sgrol mar bsam pa'i sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo/ bzhi spyi dang 'dra bar bkod nas/ lte bar yi ge a'i gdangs can gyi/ re kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba zhig bsam la/ sngar bshad pa ltar bum pa can gyi sbyor ba la 'jug ste/ de las me rab tu 'bar ba dbu ma brgyud nas/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis po khyab pas/ de thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems spyi bor 'dus/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas lte bar thim/ re zhig me'i gdung ba zhi nas bde bas khyab par bsam/ de nyid rtag tu sgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud las/ rang sngags hūṃ dang yi ge oṃ/ /rdo rje āḥyig bsam par bya/ /rlung gi de nyid rab grub nas/ /mi 'gro drag po'i ngag tu 'gyur/ /ces gsungs te/ snga ma ltar gsal ba'i lte bar ut+pal dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la/ tāṃ yig sngon po sna tshogs pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ de'i steng du thig le phra mo āḥ'i gdangs dang ldan pa/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe tāṃ de las rlung gi ngo bo 'od dmar po'i gong bu oṃ gyi gdangs dang ldan pa bung ba lta bu'i zir sgra can zhig dbu ma nas brgyud/ spyi bo dang de nas rim pas smin mtshams kyi lam nas song*/ sna sgo nas thon/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab/ snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangs ma rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par gyur pa/ 'od kyi gong bu de nyid kyis bsdus shing bslangs nas/ bung ba lta bu'i tshul gyis snga ma'i lam brgyud hūṃ gi gdangs dang bcas pas nang du byon/ de las bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung ste/ tāṃ la thim/

bung ba me tog gi dbus su sgra phra mo 'byin cing 'khor ba ltar/ tāṃ gyi thig le āḥyi gdangs su gnas par bsam la/ 'di la yang rlung gi sbyor ba ni kum pa ka la nan tan du sbyor ba yin no/ /gsum pa ni rgyud las/ 'od zer sna lnga snying gar gnas/ /pad+mas rdo rje rab dbye ba/ /thig le rdo rjer byed pa ste/ /ye shes khyab 'jug rgyal por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la'ang gzhi bca' ba snga ma bzhin/ snying ga chos 'khor gyi lte bar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su thig le rtsa na ka'i tshad tsam 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba rtag tu bsgoms te/ srog thur bsres nas snying gar drangs/ snying gar bum can kha sbyor brtan par byas nas 'di nyid cung zad goms pa na/ shes rab kyi nā ra na si ka zhes bya ba'i rtsa'i/ dang por bde skyong gi 'khor lo dang*/ de nas sprul pa dang*/ bde chen gyi 'khor lo rab tu grol nas/ snying ga'i ma rig pa'i sgo nga rnam par 'byed par byed pa yin te/ des 'od gsal mchog la reg par 'gyur ro/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis snying ga'i bum pa can cung zad brtan nas/ a pa na bhañdza zhes bya ba'i man ngag zhig ston par mdzad mod kyi/ lag len rtsub pa zhig snang bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i rim pa de rnams spyod pa gsum gyi mtshams sbyar nas/ dngos grub mchog la nye bar sbyor ba'o/ /bgrang yas legs spyad rlung bzhon dang 'grogs ha ri tsan dan nags kyi dpal mor ci dgar rol pa'i rta dmar can/ /dpyod ldan yid kyi gdung sel gang zhig mos dga'i lang tshos mchog tu bskal bzang dga' ma'i yid kyi lcags kyu ste/ /mtha' dag srid gsum rol pa'i chu mtshor rnyog bral zhabs sen zla ris nam yang 'god mkhas rje btsun bla ma de'i/ / gsung gi 'od dkar rnam par spro bas dge legs rab byin ge sar lang tsho bzhad pa'i ku mud rmad byung ba/ /gang 'di blo gros 'dab rgyas zab don gyi/

/ sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas thar 'dod mig yangs ma'i/ /mgo dang rna ba'i rgyan du rtag 'god pa/ /yon tan ldan pa'i rang bzhin su yi 'gog /rigs sngags 'chang dbang mi bdag tshul 'dzin pas/ /rnam par bskul phyir sngon med lam gyi srol/ /tā ra nā thas phyogs tsam brjod pa yi/ /dge ba de yang sems can kun la bsngo/ /zhes pa'ang rang lo nyer bdun pa la g.yo ru gong dkar gyi pho brang du sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel// zhus dag/ bkra shis// bdag gis dge ba gang bsags 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde mchog spel ba'i/ / bla na med pa'i rgyu tshogs nyid gyur cig /ces pa'i dge ba bsngo ba 'di ma tis bris// // sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i khrid yig bde chen myur gter bzhugs/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - PAGE 386 -- PAGE 371 -- PAGE 370 -
